All grading prompts use frozen runtime-v7 instructions; their actual grading payload and output example remain byte-identical. Old evidence is preserved, not relabeled as current observations.

nonempty_execution_queue.prerequisite: The root must bind the current runtime lock and verify every input/artifact hash before real execution.

limitations: No nonempty answer was submitted to any model or replayed as an authored judgment.
Empty-result success is not evidence of stored-answer semantic correctness, full model scores, signed token/DB/XP behavior, or formal semantic-review completion.
